evidence.observation: First failure from 10.0.5.20 (VULNSCAN01) at 10:02:00Z, inside the approved scan window.
Failures sweep many accounts from the scanner at a steady pace; the pattern looks like spraying but the source is the scanner.
Sweep ends at about 10:26Z, before the CHG-1042 window closes at 10:30Z; svc-scanner also logged on successfully at the start.

rationale: Authenticated vulnerability scanning legitimately tries many accounts. The asset inventory identifies 10.0.5.20 as the scanner and change CHG-1042 approves exactly 10:00-10:30Z. Suppress that source only inside that window so the same address misused later is still detected.
